items.clause: MVStättVO §1 Abs.2 S.1 Nr.1 (seats at tables)
items.paraphrase: For seating at tables the visitor count is one person per square metre of the assembly room floor area; standing places count at least two per m2.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: bauministerkonferenz.de/Dokumente/4231724917250.pdf; MVStättVO Fassung Juni 2005, amended 07/2014; room floor area excluding areas visitors cannot access; applies only to venues above the §1(1) size thresholds

items.clause: ASR A2.3 Tab.1 row 1 col B (door, up to 5 persons); 0.90 for 6-50 persons (rows 2-3)
items.paraphrase: A door on a main escape route serving up to five people may be 0.80 m clear; for more people at least 0.90 m, and 0.90 is recommended for new builds.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: digiasr.blogs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de ASR-A2.3_markiert.pdf (unofficial reading copy of the GMBl text); ASR A2.3 Ausgabe März 2022; workplace rule, not building code

items.clause: ASR A2.3 Tab.1 col C rows 5-7 (1.20 m/200, 1.80 m/300, 2.40 m/400 persons)
items.paraphrase: Clear main-escape-route width is 1.20 m at 200 persons, 1.80 m at 300 and 2.40 m at 400, about 6 mm per person; door column B gives 1.05/1.65/2.25 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: same file; derived by division from a stepped table (no stated per-person figure); door column B is slightly lower (about 5.3-5.6 mm)

items.clause: ASR A2.3 Tab.1 col C (all persons of all levels in the catchment) and Tab.2 (stairs, per level)
items.paraphrase: Stairs in stair enclosures use the same total-persons table as corridors (about 6 mm per person), or alternatively Table 2 with 1.00 m up to 30 persons per level.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: same file; derived; Tab.2 alternative: 1.00 m to 30 persons/level, 1.20 to 40, 1.40 to 50, 1.80 to 60, 2.40 to 70; building-code stair width is DIN 18065 (not read)

items.clause: MBO §30 Abs.2 Nr.2 (innere Brandwand)
items.paraphrase: Extended buildings must be divided by internal fire walls at spacings of no more than 40 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: bauministerkonferenz.de/Dokumente/42323530.pdf; MBO Fassung Nov 2002, amended 25.09.2020 (2022 amendment not read); Muster-Industriebaurichtlinie uses area-based compartments for industrial buildings (not read)

items.clause: MBO §30 Abs.3 S.1 (Brandwand: feuerbeständig, nichtbrennbar, with mechanical load); §29 Abs.3 Trennwand min. feuerhemmend
items.paraphrase: Internal fire walls must be fire-resistant (feuerbeständig) and non-combustible even under added mechanical loading; ordinary partitions need the floor's resistance, at least feuerhemmend.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: MBO §29/§30 read (bauministerkonferenz.de/Dokumente/42323530.pdf) and name the classes, but the minute figures (feuerbeständig = 90, feuerhemmend = 30 for Trennwand floor) come from the MVV TB / DIN 4102 / EN 13501 convention, not MBO text

items.clause: MBO §35 Abs.4 S.1 Nr.2 (Gebäudeklasse 4, up to 13 m: hochfeuerhemmend under mechanical load); Nr.3 GK 3 feuerhemmend
items.paraphrase: Escape-stair enclosure walls in class-4 buildings (up to 13 m) must be highly fire-retardant including mechanical impact; class 3 only fire-retardant.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: clause read in the MBO PDF, but the minute conversion (hochfeuerhemmend = 60, feuerhemmend = 30) is from MVV TB / DIN 4102-2 / EN 13501, not MBO text

items.clause: MBO §35 Abs.4 S.1 Nr.1 (Gebäudeklasse 5: Bauart von Brandwänden); §30 Abs.3
items.paraphrase: In class-5 buildings (above 13 m) the stair enclosure walls must be built to fire-wall standard, i.e. fire-resistant and non-combustible under mechanical load.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: clause read in the MBO PDF; 90 min is the standard value of feuerbeständig, not in MBO text; trigger is height above 13 m (GK 5, §2 Abs.3), not storeys; high-rise (above 22 m) is under the Muster-Hochhaus-Richtlinie (not read)
